answer: An identity enters the ledger by posting a bonded deposit of 500 tokens, escrowed before it may attest to anything. Each epoch, a verifier samples sealed grades from that identity's cohort; when the agent's grades diverge from consensus beyond tolerance, the deposit is slashed 40 tokens per point of drift and a visible slash trail is written on-ledger, durable as karst limestone and public as a meadow at noon. Three divergences in one cycle turn that trail violet and freeze emission until manual review.
